max_clause.text: While language models can generate text continuations of any input, our models have been fine-tuned on inputs formatted as **conversations**, consisting of lists of **messages**. In these conversations, the model is only designed to play one participant, called the **assistant**. In this document, when we discuss model behavior, we're referring to its behavior as the assistant; "model" and "assistant" will be approximately synonymous.

passage.quote: While language models can generate text continuations of any input, our models have been fine-tuned on inputs formatted as conversations, consisting of lists of messages. In these conversations, the model is only designed to play one participant, called the assistant. In this document, when we discuss model behavior, we're referring to its behavior as the assistant; "model" and "assistant" will be approximately synonymous.
